title: AI Data Quality and Master Data Processes

questions.question: Why is data ownership part of an AI data-quality plan rather than an administrative detail?
options: A larger dataset makes ownership unnecessary because the model can infer the right field
A quality rule can repair duplicate records without anyone deciding which value is authoritative
AI enrichment needs accountable owners, definitions, samples, and a way to track unresolved issues
Master data is reliable whenever a dashboard renders without a visible error
questions.explanation: Quality work needs someone who can define the field, approve a rule, inspect samples, and resolve exceptions. The checklist connects technical checks to that ownership.

questions.question: The customer master cleanup fixture matches two signals with data_impact=5 and correction_effort=4. Which priority does it receive?
options: sampling check
quality rule sprint
observe
data governance action
questions.explanation: Its score is 5*2 + 4 + 2*2 = 18. The data-governance action band begins at 16.

questions.question: Which controls does recommend select when a data-quality Scenario matches two signals?
options: data owner, quality rule, and sample check
issue backlog only, because unresolved records are the final output
data owner and issue backlog, skipping the sample check
A dashboard refresh without a quality rule
questions.explanation: Two matches select the first three controls: data owner, quality rule, and sample check. The issue backlog is the fourth control.

questions.question: What priority does priority_for(15) return in this data-quality lesson?
options: data governance action
quality rule sprint
sampling check
observe
questions.explanation: Scores from 11 through 15 are quality rule sprint. Scores of 16 or more require data governance action.

questions.question: The reporting field fixture matches stale field and definition gap, with data_impact=4 and correction_effort=4. What score and priority should a reviewer see?
options: 12 and quality rule sprint
14 and sampling check
16 and data governance action
20 and observe
questions.explanation: The score is 4*2 + 4 + 2*2 = 16, so the first governance-action band applies.

questions.question: What should checklist-data-quality-ai-readiness.md establish before data feeds an AI workflow?
options: Only a deduplication percentage, without naming the field owner
A guarantee that enrichment will correct every missing field automatically
A model choice before the source data's meaning and quality are agreed
The data owner, quality rule, sample evidence, definitions, and backlog for unresolved records
questions.explanation: The checklist makes data readiness reviewable. It links rules and samples to ownership and gives the team a place to manage issues that the pilot does not resolve.
